# Lumen 1.3.4

A pretty big update focused on making backups smoother to control and fixing a handful of annoying edge cases. Moved the remaining screens onto the official Material 3 Expressive library, brought over proper mid-file **Pause & Resume** from the desktop app, added per-folder **Delete after backup**, fixed the GPS metadata and duplicate upload bug, added a **What's New** screen, a **Quick Settings** tile, and launcher shortcuts, and cleaned up tablet, foldable, and landscape layouts along with another bug and security pass.

---

### New Features & UI
- **Pause, Resume & Per-Item Retry**: Uploads now send in 512 KiB resumable chunks, so pausing mid-file holds your place instead of restarting from 0%. You can pause or resume from the **Backup** card, the active upload notification, or the **Quick Settings** tile, and tap any failed item in the queue to retry just that file.
- **Per-Folder Delete After Backup** (#19): You can now turn on **Delete after backup** per folder (like `Screenshots` or `Downloads`) inside **Add Folder** and **Edit Folder**, without turning it on globally for `Camera Roll`. Folders with it enabled show an **Auto-delete** badge in **Folders**.
- **What's New**: Added a **What's New** page inside **About** going all the way back to v1.0.0 with unread dots on the latest version, plus a one-time summary sheet the first time you open the app after updating.
- **Quick Settings Tile & App Shortcuts**: Added a **Sync Lumen** tile in Android Quick Settings to start or pause backups from your shade, and long-press shortcuts on the app icon to jump straight into **Sync Folders** or **Pick Media**.
- **More Material 3 Expressive Polish**: Switched to the official Compose Material 3 Expressive library and updated the remaining screens, dialogs, segmented lists, loading indicators, touch targets, and seasonal theme contrast to match the rest of the app.
- **Tablet, Foldable & Tabletop Polish**: Added hinge-aware Tabletop mode across all screens (including a live Folder Inspector in **Folders**), capped bottom sheets below the horizontal crease, anchored Google Sign-In and form dialogs to the upper half so the keyboard sits cleanly on the lower half, fixed two-pane layouts on unfolded foldables and large tablets, added proper cutout and keyboard insets, and kept pending Share Sheet uploads intact when folding or rotating.
- **Cleaner Mock Mode & Seasonal Overlays**: Moved the Mock Mode toggles off the **Backup** screen into a floating **Mock** button and bottom sheet (and cleared duplicate toggles out of **Settings**). Also rewrote the Christmas snow and Halloween bats so they loop smoothly instead of resetting every few seconds.

---

### Bug Fixes & Improvements
- **GPS Metadata & Duplicate Uploads** (#22): Added `ACCESS_MEDIA_LOCATION` (with an automatic request for existing installs that don't use All Files Access) and wrapped MediaStore reads with `MediaStore.setRequireOriginal()`. GPS location tags stay intact now, and already-backed-up photos hash properly instead of uploading duplicates.
- **In-App Update Detection**: Separated the app-open update check timer from the 4-hour background worker so opening Lumen actually picks up new releases, cached background-found updates with SHA-256 checks, added a 24-hour snooze when you dismiss the sheet, and showed download errors inline inside the update sheet.
- **Pick Media & Pick Files Account Selection**: Fixed a bug where choosing a different **Account** in the upload dialog still uploaded to whichever account was active on the home screen.
- **Background Sync & Notifications**: Fixed `MediaContentJobService` cancelling itself on start, fixed an Android 15+ boot foreground-service race, wired Android 16+ Live Update progress chips (including single-file percentages), updated background worker notifications to show paused state, and fixed folder watcher debounce and rescan races.
- **Queue & Onboarding Stability**: Fixed a race where a finishing upload could clear the active state of a new run, stopped paused uploads from blocking **Album Sync**, kept staged Share/Picker files around on failure so **Tap to retry** works, refreshed expired tokens mid-file after long pauses, and fixed **Onboarding** showing no starter folders if you had cleared folders earlier.
- **Small Polish**: Stopped Mock Mode toggles (offline, missing album, theme, forced season, What's New preview) from leaking into real settings, shortened **Pick Media** / **Pick Files** labels so they stop clipping, and cleaned up completion summary text and stray periods in **Settings**.

---

### Internationalization & Translations
- **Synced Strings**: Extracted the remaining hardcoded English strings across completion summaries, condition notices, remaining-time labels, **What's New**, the Quick Settings tile, shortcuts, and per-folder auto-delete. English and Indonesian are synced at 624 keys.

---

### Security Hardening
- **Intent & FileProvider Guards**: Blocked `@` user-scoped authority prefixes (like `content://0@...`) so external apps can't bypass the self-`FileProvider` check, removed unauthenticated shortcut action bypasses so shortcut launches require `internal_token`, and restricted Photo Picker ID lookups to local MediaStore picker providers.
- **Auto-Delete & Updater Checks**: Blocked symlinks and unassigned folders from triggering post-backup deletion, checked for other accounts still uploading a shared file before deleting it, rejected blank SHA-256 overrides and empty APKs, and added a 12-hour expiry on cached pending updates.
- **Logs & Sign-In WebView**: Redacted `userMessage`, `suggestedAction`, exported log files, shared run summaries, `androidId`, and custom album names; kept Google sign-in cookies intact across screen rotation while requiring `https` on cookie capture.
